# Would You Rather

> Would You Rather is a free web game of curated two-choice questions for families, couples and friends, with a Kids & Family pack written for ages 4 to 11. Every question can be played free in the browser at https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app, with no account.

## Question lists for parents and families

- [Would You Rather Questions for Kids](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/would-you-rather-questions-for-kids): 25 would you rather questions for kids, written for ages 5 to 10. Tap any question to play it with your child in seconds. Free, no sign-up.
- [Funny Would You Rather Questions for Kids](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/funny-would-you-rather-questions-for-kids): 20 funny would you rather questions for kids: spaghetti hair, penguin walks and sneezing confetti. Silly enough for giggles, clean enough for anyone.
- [Would You Rather Questions for Kindergarten](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/would-you-rather-questions-for-kindergarten): 20 would you rather questions for kindergarten and preschool kids, ages 4 to 6. Short choices they can picture: puppies or kittens, swings or slide.
- [Would You Rather Questions for Elementary Students](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/would-you-rather-questions-for-elementary-students): 20 would you rather questions for elementary students (grades 1–5). Mind-reading, volcano field trips and robot friends: great for class or the car.
- [Gross Would You Rather Questions](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/gross-would-you-rather-questions): 15 gross would you rather questions for kids: worm sandwiches, slime socks and pudding pools. Disgusting enough to delight, clean enough for dinner.
- [This or That Questions for Kids](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/this-or-that-questions-for-kids): 20 this or that questions for kids: pizza or tacos, cats or dogs, space or ocean. Fast two-word picks for little kids, car rides and getting to know you.
- [Thanksgiving Would You Rather Questions](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/thanksgiving-would-you-rather-questions): 15 Thanksgiving would you rather questions for kids and family: pie vs turkey, kids table vs grown-ups table. Fun for the table while dinner cooks.
- [Christmas Would You Rather Questions for Kids](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/christmas-would-you-rather-questions-for-kids): 18 Christmas would you rather questions for kids: elves or reindeer, snowman or snowball fight. Festive, free and ready to play at the table or by the tree.
- [Would You Rather Questions for Family](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/would-you-rather-questions-for-family): 20 would you rather questions for the whole family: switch jobs for a day, family band or sports team. Made for game night with kids and grandparents.
- [Family Dinner Conversation Starters](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/dinner-table-conversation-starters): 20 family dinner questions and conversation starters for kids: dinner on the moon, best part of your day, oldest or youngest. Phones down, talking up.
- [Road Trip Would You Rather Questions](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/road-trip-would-you-rather-questions): 20 road trip would you rather questions for kids: flying cars, rest-stop treasure, moose or bear. A no-screens car game for the whole family. Free.
- [The Would You Rather App](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/would-you-rather-app): A free would you rather app that runs in your browser: nothing to install, no account. Kids & Family pack, dinner, road trip and couples questions.
- [Questions to Ask Your Kids](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/questions-to-ask-your-kids): 20 questions to ask your kids that get more than "fine", plus how to keep them talking. Would you rather picks about friends, school, worries and kindness.

## Question lists for couples and adults

- [Deep Would You Rather Questions](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/deep-would-you-rather-questions): Deep Would You Rather questions about values, desires and what people rarely say out loud. Ideal for late nights and real conversations. Free to start.
- [Would You Rather Questions for Couples](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/questions-for-couples): 20 would you rather questions for couples: weekend trips, tiny houses, matching tattoos. Play them together and find out where you really agree.
- [Questions to Ask Your Partner](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/questions-to-ask-your-partner): 20 questions to ask your partner, as would you rather choices: money, families, holidays, the future. Easier to answer than "where is this going?"
- [First Date Questions (That Feel Like a Game)](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/first-date-questions): 20 first date questions as a would you rather game: coffee or mini-golf, dog or cat, festival or cabin. Fun to answer, easy to follow up, no awkward silence.
- [Couples Games for Date Night](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/couples-games): A free couples game you can play tonight: would you rather for date night, in your browser with no app or account. Fifteen date-night picks to start.
- [Would You Rather Questions for Adults](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/would-you-rather-questions-for-adults): 20 would you rather questions for adults: taxes or groceries, retire at 40 or rich at 65, more time or more money. Grown-up dilemmas, not explicit ones.

## Question lists for groups and teens

- [Would You Rather Questions](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/would-you-rather-questions): 25 good would you rather questions anyone can answer: fame or fortune, teleport or read minds, rewind or pause. Tap any question to play it free.
- [Funny Would You Rather Questions](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/funny-would-you-rather-questions): 20 funny would you rather questions: horse-sized duck or 100 duck-sized horses, a personal theme song or a laugh track. Silly, clean and ready for any group.
- [Hard Would You Rather Questions](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/hard-would-you-rather-questions): 20 hard would you rather questions with no easy answer: lose your past or your future, save five strangers or one you love. Built for real debates.
- [Would You Rather Questions for Teens](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/would-you-rather-questions-for-teens): 20 would you rather questions for teens: no phone or no friends for a month, streamer or athlete, prom with your crush or your best friend. Clean and relatable.
- [Would You Rather Questions for Work](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/would-you-rather-questions-for-work): 20 would you rather questions for work: no meetings or no email, 4-day week or work from anywhere. Office-safe icebreakers for meetings and team building.
- [Would You Rather Generator](https://wyr-timfong888.vercel.app/would-you-rather-generator): Free would you rather generator: tap for a random question from hundreds of clean, curated choices. Play it in your browser, no app or account needed.
